drivingQuestion: Must the trees be planted in rows for a mostly planted karpef to be permitted?
outcomeNote: Amoraic dispute recorded without decision in this unit

segments.he: נָטַע רוּבּוֹ — הֲרֵי הוּא כְּחָצֵר, וּמוּתָּר. אָמַר רַב יְהוּדָה אָמַר אֲבִימִי: וְהוּא שֶׁעֲשׂוּיִין אִצְטַבְּלָאוֹת. וְרַב נַחְמָן אָמַר: אַף עַל פִּי שֶׁאֵין עֲשׂוּיִין אִצְטַבְּלָאוֹת.
segments.en: It was stated earlier that if «the greater part of» the karpef «was planted» with trees, «it is» considered «like a courtyard, and» it is «permitted» to carry. «Rav Yehuda said» that «Avimi said: This is» only if the trees «were planted in rows [itztablaot],» the customary manner of planting ornamental trees in a courtyard. But if they were arranged differently it is considered an orchard, which is not made for dwelling, and where it is prohibited to carry. «But Rav Naḥman said:» This applies «even if they were not planted in rows,» as people commonly plant trees in any arrangement in the courtyards of their houses.

moves.cueHe: נטע רובו — הרי הוא כחצר, ומותר
moves.summary: lemma of the baraita on a mostly planted karpef
moves.about: lemma: a karpef mostly planted with trees is like a courtyard and permitted

moves.cueHe: אמר רב יהודה אמר אבימי: והוא שעשויין אצטבלאות
moves.about: the planted karpef is permitted only if planted in rows

moves.cueHe: ורב נחמן אמר: אף על פי שאין עשויין אצטבלאות
moves.summary: even if not planted in rows
moves.about: whether a karpef mostly planted with trees is permitted only when the trees are planted in rows

positions.claim: only if the trees are planted in rows (as ornamental courtyard trees)
positions.basis: rows mark trees as part of a dwelling; otherwise it is an orchard

positions.claim: even if not planted in rows
positions.basis: people plant courtyard trees in any arrangement
